meta.warning: Every rate marked VERIFY_RATE must be replaced with the current official rate from NEPRA, OGRA or the company before this site is used for real estimates. Do not publish a numeric total as official while any rate is still VERIFY_RATE.
meta.how_to_update: Open data/tariffs.json, find the company, replace each VERIFY_RATE with a number (PKR), update last_updated and source_url, then redeploy. The calculator reads this file, so no JavaScript change is needed.

lesco.name: LESCO
lesco.source: NEPRA S.R.O. 279(I)/2026 (Feb 2026), uniform A-1/A-2/B1 schedule, as published in the IESCO Tariff Guide — checked 2026-11-01. Applies uniformly to XWDISCOs and K-Electric.

domestic_non_protected.label: Domestic — Non-protected (all units at final band rate)

industrial.label: Industrial — B1 up to 25 kW (flat rate)

charges.income_tax_note: Section 235 / further tax rules vary by consumer and bill history — fill from the official tariff note, do not guess.
charges.charges_note: Total shown includes base energy + fixed charge + electricity duty (1.5%) + GST (18%) + TV fee (Rs 35, domestic). It EXCLUDES that month's FPA and quarterly adjustment, arrears, surcharges and meter rent, which vary by month — compare with the official bill.

notes: Protected = 200 units or less in each of the last 6 months (IESCO Tariff Guide, S.R.O. 279(I)/2026). A protected consumer using more than 200 units in a month is billed at non-protected rates — the calculator warns about this.
Non-protected: every unit is charged at the rate of the band the month's total falls in, not split telescopically. Protected: units are split across slabs in order.
Fixed charges for domestic are Rs/kW/month and depend on the band (Rs 200-675/kW). Enter your sanctioned load (kW) from your bill; the calculator defaults to 1 kW and labels it so.

Commercial shown is A-2 up to 5 kW (Rs 37.44, fixed Rs 1,000/month). Loads 5 kW and above use Rs 39.76 flat or TOU peak 43.82 / off-peak 35.15 with Rs 1,250/kW — not yet in this calculator. Industrial shown is B1 up to 25 kW only; larger / TOU industrial tariffs are not yet in this calculator.

Lifeline (up to 50 units at Rs 3.95, 51-100 at Rs 7.74, no fixed charge) is a separate sub-category inside the protected schedule and is not a separate calculator option yet — a lifeline bill will be lower than the protected estimate shown here.
